messages:
maria: incident-bot sent pages for prod-ml but routing headers appear truncated, oncall never received escalation. customers seeing 503s. paging history shows delivered -> unknown-escalation-policy. anyone else seeing this?
aj: confirmed, no pages for current rotation. switching to manual paging. @kevin can you escalate via PD console? :warning:
kevin: doing manual page now. PD escalation triggered to SRE rotation, pinged on-call via phone. also opening a temporary incident channel.
incident-bot: delivered page id=pg_0a1b2c routing_meta=(truncated) header_len=64 expected_len=256 ack_status=none
leah: looking at notifier-proxy logs — seeing X-Routing header truncated at 128 bytes during proxy forward. reproducing locally with a long routing payload:
```
curl -v -H "X-Routing: $(python -c 'print("a"*200)')" http://notifier-proxy.local/pager
```
leah: notifier-proxy v1.4.2 introduced a header buffer limit change. seems to trim headers over 128 bytes. this strips escalation metadata that PD uses to map to policies.
ops-bot: incident-bot healthcheck: version=2.3.1 last_deploy=2026-02-10T14:12:00Z uptime=12d
maria: customer impact so far: ~12 customers saw 503s in last 7m, 1 enterprise opened support ticket. PD shows first auto-escalation attempt failed for ~6m. we need live mitigation and a followup.
kevin: mitigation plan: rollback notifier-proxy to v1.4.0 and restart incident-bot to flush cached routes. initiating rollback now.
deploy-bot: rollback start: service=notifier-proxy target=1.4.0 initiator=kevin
deploy-bot: rollback complete: notifier-proxy v1.4.0 healthy (3/3)
leah: verified — header length restored, PD receives full routing metadata, test pages now map to correct escalation policy. replays show pages delivered across rotation.
aj: live actions captured: 1) manual page to PD (kevin) 2) rollback notifier-proxy (kevin) 3) monitor for new pages and customer errors (maria).
kevin: followups: patch notifier-proxy to encode routing metadata in body when >120 bytes OR implement header chunking. I'll own the integration test to catch oversized headers.
leah: I'll own the code patch to change routing to body-encoded fallback and add a canary config.
maria: I'll open the incident in our tracker, start a short postmortem and notify affected customers. timeline + runbook will be added.
incident-bot: created incident record: INC-2026-045 (channel #incident-prod-ml, severity=sev2)
aj: action items assigned. closing live thread unless something new pops up. :thumbsup:
